name: astrocyte
description: Persistent memory for Codex. Adds the astrocyte-memory skill. The memory server itself is registered by `astrocyte setup`.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted persistent memory for AI coding workflows
interface.longDescription: Astrocyte gives Codex long-term memory that stays on your machine: one local SQLite file, local embeddings, no server and no API key. Store decisions, preferences and project context; recall them in any later session. Install with `uv tool install 'astrocyte[local]'` then `astrocyte setup`.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we decided about the auth flow last week
Remember that deploys are frozen on Fridays
What do we know about why we chose SQLite here?
